leadText: Haruka Tomatsu (Japanese: 戸松 遥 Tomatsu Haruka) is a Japanese seiyū for .
plainText:
Haruka Tomatsu (Japanese: 戸松 遥 Tomatsu Haruka) is a Japanese seiyū for . 

==Biography==
Tomatsu was born on February 4, 1990 in , , and became seiyū and singer as an adult. Tomatsu's joined during the fourteenth movie as minor role, . In , her role was character of the day Jessica. In , Tomatsu's major role was Mina, one of the Trial Captains. Tomatsu is currently affiliated with and a member of Japanese idol group, . She also won both Best Supporting Actress and Synergy Award during the of 2013 and the of 2015, respectively. on Jan 11, 2019, Tomatsu had announced her marriages and had a child in 2021.
